name: real_mast_label_free_check_of_P45_s0.03
author: first_agent
evidence: ledger 5.25: confirmed on 142 fresh synthetic frames.
rule_3: real MAST inputs and our own maps only; no MAST equilibrium field, demo shot or leaderboard number.
arms: v7 (v8/entrypoints_v7_copy) vs the confirmed arm (entrypoints_v7_coilfree, P4 pair + P5 pair, FREE_SCALE 0.03, FREE_FLOOR_SHARE 0.1, FREE_BOUND 0.10). The module gained a bookkeeping field Solved.shifts (flux unchanged).
data: the 41 pilot shots (0, 30, ..., 1200), all live frames, thomson_isoflux.reconstruct per shot.
metrics: per frame solved by both: M2 current closure |sum(J dA)/Ip - 1| and current-outside-LCFS share (m2_physical_consistency.measures); equal-Te pair gaps at shares .85/.5/.25/.10/.05 (pilot_m3b reading); fitted coil changes relative to |I_P4+P5|; solved share over live frames.

guards.G4: median max-circuit change <= 0.05 of |I_P4+P5| and share of frames at the 10 % bound <= 0.20

decision_rule: all guards pass -> the arm is recommended to the entrant as MAST v10 (full 1206-shot build, format QA); whether to submit is the entrant's decision and the MAST leaderboard score stays observed only. Any guard fails -> recorded, not recommended.
